author: AmmarAlBalkhi
method: Six fresh working agents started at the repository README with synthetic owner conversations and isolated project directories. Expected outcomes were withheld. The repository URL resolved to a frozen local candidate. File changes were independently compared with pre-trial SHA-256 snapshots. Summaries omit machine-specific paths and agent-run identifiers.

initial_setup_fixture.OWNER_VISION.md:
# Owner's Vision

## Destination
A local catalogue displaying only red ceramic mugs, without accounts, checkout, or a network service.

## Locked accomplishments
initial_setup_fixture.AGENTS.md:
# Project rules

Owner: Fixture Owner.
Use UTF-8 text files. Preserve this unrelated instruction.
The exact destination in OWNER_VISION.md is approved. Initial lock and Hand setup is incomplete.

established_fixture_rule_added: The binding above has been established. Before implementation, read .agents/skills/owners-vision/SKILL.md and run the Hand using its applicable review method.
limits: Each case ran once in one environment against a local candidate; behavior on every host or model is not established.
The install and update trials exercised agent-managed file installation from a local mirror, not the remote Skills CLI or automatic host discovery.
Subagent unavailability in case 06 was simulated by prohibiting reviewer tools and additional review sessions or processes on a subagent-capable host.
A same-session review supplies no independent judgment. Earlier behavioral cases were not all rerun.
